tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.emptyHint: Tasks are created by an assistant with the miloco plugin (e.g. OpenClaw) and show up here
tasks.confirmDeleteMessage: Delete “{{desc}}”? Its rules and records go too. This can't be undone.
tasks.rulesManagedHint: You can edit the trigger; it applies right away. Actions and alerts are managed by your assistant — just tell it what to change.
tasks.triggerPlaceholder: What counts, e.g. the child is studying at the desk
tasks.triggerPhrasingHint: Describe something happening. Avoid “detected…” — it gets treated as already true.
tasks.howToTitle: To add a task, just tell your assistant
tasks.howToBody: Tasks are created by an assistant with the miloco plugin and wired to rules — the web page can't create them. Just say something like:
tasks.example1: Watch that my kid practices piano daily; remind me after 30 minutes
tasks.example2: Remind my parents to check their blood pressure once a day
tasks.example3: Tell me if a window is still open when nobody's home
